title: Add ChatController _providers[0] empty guard
description: P1 — ChatController.ResolveProvider accesses _providers[0] with no guard. If no IChatProvider implementations are registered (misconfiguration or startup race), this throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException at runtime with no helpful diagnostic. Fix: add _providers.Count > 0 guard before index access; log warning and return 503 Service Unavailable with clear message when no providers are registered. Found in 10-agent codebase audit 2026-07-10 (P1-010).
